connector.name: Formio Uag
connector.registryDescription: The Universal Agent Gateway (UAG) enables in-process agentic automation using Form.io.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package uag. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.form, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: PROJECT
env.description: API endpoint to Enterprise project or OSS server

env.name: ADMIN_KEY
env.description: Server admin key for Community Edition. Not required for Enterprise deployment.

env.name: UAG_LICENSE
env.description: License for Enterprise deployment. Not required for Community Edition.

env.name: JWT_SECRET
env.description: Secret used to generate and validate JWT tokens

env.name: PROJECT_TTL
env.description: Project cache refresh interval in seconds (default: 900)

env.name: BASE_URL
env.description: The URL clients reach the UAG at. Published in the .well-known OIDC (PKCE) definitions and used for authentication callbacks, so remote agents cannot authenticate without it. Must be a public URL when remote agents connect in; a private or localhost URL is fine for a local MCP client.

env.name: LOGIN_FORM
env.description: Public URL to login form JSON endpoint
